The actual verifier context is 2f847b7ec1b77c20332d4bd1649f5bd5a96591bb615d13c11481d98b590cb527. Current task state is WAITING_FOR_FINAL_REVIEW.

The closed four-operation API separates stable task/version/material/action inputs from exact-reference live current authority. Preparation and recording enforce native V2, current specification/classification/approval facts, independent actor labels, required action facts, supported ordinary installation and parent bytecode-disabled startup. Node policies remain rejected. The namespace selector, complete canonical parameter summary, shared task consumption lock, exclusive use receipt and launch claim preserve single-use authority across concurrent or interrupted attempts. Failed recordings retain spent authority and originals. No arbitrary probe/operator/command/environment selector or new public lifecycle capability is introduced.

The fixed execution path preserves the ordinary installed distribution/dependency/startup/RECORD closure and independent copied baseline/mutant file identities. The 001 operator changes only the unique expected extras comparison while retaining the complete declaration and positive policy control; the other four transformations match the existing native operators and preserve outside-target AST. Children use the bound interpreter with -I -S -B, fresh empty pycache prefixes, exact copied-site imports and fixed environment. Loaded module names must resolve to legitimate bound module/package/extension paths. Closed canonical reports, complete case order and setup/call/teardown, exact observations, the sole designated call-phase AssertionError anchor, empty stderr, raw-stream hashes and full Windows Job/EOF/cleanup receipts distinguish killed from survived or unrelated exit 1. Unsupported source shapes, altered copies, changed bytecode/origins, incomplete streams, timeouts and uncertain cleanup fail closed. These guarantees retain the stated trusted interpreter/stdlib/loader/OS assumptions.

The authority collector validates closed references and historical snapshot shapes before historical Git arguments, checks HEAD-tree identity, ancestry and exact governance-only committed/cached paths, then derives only the collector-verified physical Git allowances. The pure reader binds Current to identical ref/size/SHA, rereads complete current membership and protected byte/identity inventories, validates action/approval/consumption/launch/completion originals, preserves immutable review and event/approval prefixes and permits only registered governance advancement, including the same-verifier IMPLEMENTING-to-VERIFYING transition. Only the exact reference-owned run is excluded; there is no Git/task/logs directory exemption. Typed dataclasses are explicitly not authentication and callers must obtain Current from the collector. Replay contains no process, recovery or repair path.

Companion tests were examined for real Git/ledger/action transactions, concurrent and interrupted claims, complete inventory and metadata rejection, cross-reference Current reuse, malformed historical data before Git use, source/dependency/material drift, rehashed report/receipt/copy tampering, valid-name/wrong-path module substitution, nonempty stderr and exact mutation attribution. Portable logical fixtures retain an explicit failure marker and do not claim actual execution. The ordinary-wheel tests use real copied installed bytes and actual Windows Jobs; instrumentation imports only the coverage collector and remaps measurements only after byte-identical installed/source comparisons. The cold-import case alone disables its incompatible collector while keeping the irreversible write/process audit and original installation inventory. The repaired concurrent/failure assertions retain exact spent-action, one-consumption/claim/start and fail-closed authority requirements. No gate or threshold was removed.

Observed current native pre evidence at .ai/tasks/TASK-0135/logs/run-20261101T172206415217Z/evidence.json equals current task evidence and has raw SHA 96b7497fcc3118572c92f7ac152cd6398fcf00aebd07ecb947904f948d7b5024. These are observed originals, not CLI-exit-only success or a rerun by this reviewer.

The separately retained ordinary direct and sdist-rebuilt IQ originals were independently reread with this exact native candidate. Exact reference digests remain direct 7a5cb110de57a617b5931f4e8e538dd85c3b7e0bf08acdafeb978e3959f20213 and rebuilt e9433c12dea10a28618f99b5e0162f2382a9e17c5e35520b0840701abc6458b1. The original run/completion, before==after, all five exact overlays and complete retained closure/report/stream/receipt originals per origin were checked through the actual pure pair reader; every outcome is killed. This rereads ten actual baseline/mutant pairs and twenty Job originals, not twenty new processes. A process/filesystem-write audit guard was active during pure original reading and no attempt occurred. No new pair, suite, action approval, consumption, finalization or code approval was performed by this implementation review.

Previous failed verification, earlier spent actions, blocked prototype history and original acceptance materials remain preserved. This approval is limited to the reviewed native primitive implementation and current local verification facts. Root must record this review, the same independent verifier must finalize the unchanged snapshot, and code approval/Gate plus current-head required remote CI remain separate delivery gates. This review does not activate Node V2/CI, authorize real target application, authenticate owner identity, transfer standing authorization or grant private-material export, external execution, repository-setting changes, gate weakening or history rewriting.
